name: ethos
description: The always-loaded work-ethics corpus of the Gunther Schulz Claude Code stack: evidence discipline over claims (grounding, fixing), calibration questions, insurance mechanisms, reporting conventions, and per-project accretion discipline. The corpus is delivered via `@`-imports that scripts/install-imports.sh writes into your CLAUDE.md (SessionStart hook output is too small a channel for six modules' worth of text); a SessionStart hook verifies the delivery on every session start. Routing's portable half and machine-bound bindings are not in v1.
